old: as Rigveda, Yajurveda, and Samaveda appropriately yields the term "traividhya" (threefold-ness).
new: as Rigveda, Yajurveda, and Samaveda, it became customary to call this threefold division of the three Vedas "traividhya" (threefold-ness).
basis: Kannada p.490: ವೇದಗಳನ್ನು ... ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ ಹೇಳುವುದರಿಂದ ... ತ್ರೈವಿಧ್ಯವೆಂದು ಹೇಳುವುದು ರೂಢಿಯಾಯಿತು (it became customary); English "appropriately yields" is not in the Kannada
